title: ECHO Pipeline Parameters
description: Nextflow parameter schema for the ECHO (Evolutionary Closest Homologue) pipeline.

input_output.title: Input / Output
input_output.description: Paths to input data and the output directory.

metadata_tsv.description: Path to the 4-column metadata TSV (sps_name, taxon_id, gca, file_path).

input_fasta_dir.description: Optional base directory for resolving relative file_path entries in the metadata TSV. Omit if all file_path values are absolute.

query_species.description: Path to the query species TSV (columns: sps_name, tax_id).

outdir.description: Directory where pipeline outputs are published.

workdir.description: Nextflow work directory (default: 'work'). Override when the default filesystem is unsuitable (e.g. read-only scratch).

fasta_options.title: FASTA Options
fasta_options.description: Controls how the combined FASTA is written.

fasta_line_width.description: Characters per sequence line in the output combined FASTA.

clustering.title: MMseqs2 Clustering
clustering.description: Parameters for the MMseqs2 easy-cluster step. CPU threads and memory are configured per profile in nextflow.config.

min_seq_id.description: Minimum sequence identity threshold for clustering (0–1).

coverage.description: Minimum alignment coverage threshold for clustering (0–1).

relatives.title: Closest Relatives
relatives.description: Parameters controlling which relatives are selected per query.

num_of_rel.description: Number of closest relatives to retrieve per query species per cluster.

clusters_per_chunk.description: Number of clusters per parallel chunk when searching for closest relatives.

with_singletons.description: Include singleton proteins (clusters of size 1) in the final all_relatives FASTA. Singletons are low-support but retained as coverage evidence for rare or divergent families. Set to false for ranked-only output.

deduplication.title: Sequence Deduplication
deduplication.description: Options for deduplicating identical sequences in the output.

dedup_sequences.description: Deduplicate exact-sequence duplicates in the final all_relatives FASTA. When enabled, identical sequences are merged and a dedup_report.tsv is written per query.

ncbi_taxa_db.description: Path to a pre-built NCBITaxa sqlite database. Omit to use ete3's default (~/.etetoolkit/taxa.sqlite). Useful when running on a shared cluster where a central copy of the DB is available.

resume_mode.title: Resume / Existing Clusters
resume_mode.description: Skip re-clustering by reusing outputs from a previous pipeline run.

existing_clusters_dir.description: Path to a previous pipeline output directory. When set, steps 1–4 (parsing, MMseqs2, cluster filtering) are skipped and their outputs are read from this directory.
